title: Vacuum fourth-chaos cancellation does not supply uniform free-form control across particle number

particle_boundary.one_mode_control: For one fixed oscillator, the diagonal expectation of :(a+a*)^4: in the n-particle vector is 6n(n-1), up to the fixed positive mode normalization
particle_boundary.free_energy: The corresponding free energy plus one grows only linearly as omega n+1
particle_boundary.ratio: The diagonal quartic/free-form ratio grows linearly in n and is unbounded
particle_boundary.consequence: Even at fixed ultraviolet cutoff the full Wick quartic is not uniformly form bounded by H_0+1 across particle number
particle_boundary.domain_route: A semibounded construction may instead use a nonlinear form domain D(H_0^(1/2)) intersect D(V_+^(1/2)), as K1448 does in its changed beta>3 representation
particle_boundary.ceiling: The one-mode theorem is not an operator no-go. It says vacuum-column cancellation alone does not construct the original beta=1 all-sector form or resolvent
